transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or right when I get home. I really hate doing it, but... it's just started feeling like it's the only way I can calm down.
How often do you find yourself making yourself throw up after eating, and does it happen after most meals or only certain ones?

Well, it's been going on for months now. I'd say most weeks, there are at least two or three times where I just... eat way more than I ever meant to. And then I panic, and I have to undo it. Sometimes I throw up, but other times I just won't eat anything at all the next day, or I'll try to exercise until I'm exhausted to work it off. It's usually after those times when I just lose control and eat too much, not every single meal.
When you say you 'lose control and eat too much,' can you describe what that feels like? Do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what you're eating during those times?

Yeah, that's exactly what it is. Once I start eating... it feels like my hands just keep reaching for more food. Even while I'm in my head telling myself to stop, I just can't. It's almost like I'm watching myself do it, but I can't make myself quit until I'm just completely stuffed.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed about the way you eat, even if you don't end up purging afterward?

Yeah. I mean, definitely. I feel really ashamed. Even if I don't end up... doing anything to fix it afterward, I just sit there feeling terrible about myself. It's just... I don't know, it's really embarrassing that I can't just eat like a normal person. I just feel guilty all the time about it.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a very large amount of food in a short period, even if you don't make yourself throw up or do anything else afterward?

Yeah, I do. When it happens, I just eat so much really fast. I can go through a full family-size bag of chips, a bunch of pastries I pick up from the corner store on my way home from work, whatever leftovers are in the fridge, and wash it all down with a bunch of sweet drinks... all in one sitting. I just keep going, and before I even really notice how much is gone, I've eaten all of it.
During these times when you eat a lot very quickly, do you feel like you’re unable to stop yourself or control how much you’re eating, even if you wanted to?

Yeah, it's pretty much like I was saying a minute ago. I just... I can't stop. Once I start eating like that, the control is just completely gone. Even if I really want to quit, I just can't make myself do it.
Do these episodes of losing control while eating cause you a lot of distress, or affect your work, relationships, or daily life?

Yeah, it really does. My whole day basically ends up getting arranged around hiding what happened. Like, I'll catch myself rushing through my tasks at the laundry, or hurrying through my errands, just because my head is so preoccupied with how I'm going to make up for all that eating. And I've skipped out on after-work meals with people, too. It just takes over everything.
When you have these episodes where you eat a lot, do you feel like you’re unable to stop eating or control how much you’re eating, even if you wanted to?

Yeah, like I mentioned just before... it's exactly like that. Once I start, it feels like my hands just keep reaching for food, even while I'm in my head telling myself to stop. It's almost like I'm watching myself do it from the outside, and I just can't make myself quit. The control is just completely gone.
During these episodes where you eat a lot, do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating, even if you wanted to?

Yeah, I know I've said it a couple times now, but... yes. It's exactly that. Once I take that first bite, it's like I'm on autopilot. My hands just keep grabbing more food, and in my head, I'm screaming at myself to stop, but I just... I can't. It's honestly like I'm standing outside my own body just watching it happen, and I have absolutely zero power to hit the brakes.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a lot in a short period of time and then don’t do anything afterward like making yourself throw up or skipping meals?

No, not really. I mean, if I have one of those times where I eat like that, I always end up doing something to try and fix it. I either make myself sick or I just won't eat anything at all for a couple of days. I don't think I've ever just eaten all that and then done nothing about it.
Have you ever had times when you ate a lot in a short period and didn’t feel you could control it, but afterward you didn’t make yourself sick or skip meals?

No, I... I think I just answered that one. Like I said, if I eat a ton like that and feel out of control, I always do something afterward. I never just let it go. I'll always either throw up or just not eat for a while to make up for it.
Have you ever had times when you ate a lot in a short period and couldn’t control yourself, but afterward you didn’t make yourself sick, skip meals, or do anything else to make up for it?

No, I really haven't. I'm sorry, I feel like we're going in circles a bit, but... no. If I lose control and eat like that, I always, always have to do something to undo it. There's never been a time where I just ate and then did nothing.
When you make yourself throw up or skip meals, does it only happen after those times when you feel like you've lost control while eating?

No, sometimes I do it even if I haven't eaten a huge amount or lost control. Like, if I just eat a normal meal or even just a snack, but I feel guilty about it, I'll still make myself sick or decide not to eat the rest of the day. It doesn't always have to be after a big binge.

So you mentioned sometimes you make yourself throw up or skip meals even after eating a normal or small amount — can you clarify if this happens even when you haven't felt like you've lost control or eaten a large amount?

Yeah, that's right. I mean, even if I just eat a regular sandwich or... or a piece of fruit, and I didn't feel out of control at all, I might still go throw it up or just not eat dinner. It's just about feeling bad that I ate it, not necessarily because I ate a ton or lost control.
So, to clarify, have you ever made yourself throw up or skipped meals when you haven’t eaten a large amount or felt like you lost control of your eating?

Yeah, like I was just saying... yes, I do. Even if it's just a little bit of food and I felt totally in control, I still make myself sick or skip meals sometimes. I think we kind of just went over this, but yeah, that's exactly what happens.

Have you ever made yourself throw up or used laxatives, diuretics, or other methods to get rid of food when you haven’t had an episode where you felt out of control while eating a large amount of food?

I feel like you're asking me the exact same thing again. But yes, like I said, I've made myself throw up or just not eaten even if I didn't binge or lose control. I don't really use laxatives or those water pills, though, if that's what you're getting at. It's mostly just throwing up or skipping meals.
